description:
Professor Jiang, known for his work on predictive history, has recently gained attention for making connections that most people don’t even notice.
According to his perspective, many of the systems we live in are based on assumptions that are rarely questioned — and in some cases, may not reflect reality as it’s presented.
This video breaks down some of his ideas and examines how these connections are interpreted.
